In full support of this.  Not sure why it's stacked with other unrelated patches.

> In full support of this. Not sure why it's stacked with other unrelated patches.

Because i do not want to create these headers anymore from this point onwards in the chain.

I do not see any issue with this so i can just wait until the review arrives at this point or rebase it further down in case there are any issues with patches below.

Otherwise i would have to keep creating those copyright headers and just create merge conflict with myself.

> Because i do not want to create these headers anymore from this point onwards in the chain.

Sure, the point is that this really doesn't have anything to do with your chain itself.  Understand this is just a cleanup and you're willing to wait, it's just easier to merge quickly if chains encapsulate a piece of functionality.
The examples I see at https://spdx.github.io/spdx-spec/v2.3/file-tags/  all have 'Copyright' in the string on this line.  So does bmcweb.

There is one example
```
SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2019 Jane Doe <jane@example.com>
```
which does not have it.

Anyways, fixed it for consistency reasons since most examples do have it 👍
